sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form, unbeaten in their last five matches with four wins and a draw, and will be firm favourites against bottom-of-the-table Alsager Town, who have won just once all season and are on a five-game losing run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town at home, with the visitors looking to bounce back after a recent win but still in mid-table. The title race could see significant movement if Stafford capitalise; they sit just two points behind Sandbach with a draw in their most recent outing. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face Eccleshall at home in a direct top-four clash—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six after a recent loss, while Eccleshall have lost their last match and sit fifth. In-form Bilston Town (sixth, unbeaten in five) host Foley Meir at home looking to maintain momentum. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table and riding a recent win, travel to Wednesfield Community away. Elsewhere, struggling Crewe host Allscott Heath at home as they seek to climb away from 16th place, while New Mills visit Market Drayton Town in a mid-table fixture. Shawbury United, winless in five games, host Barnton at home in a match both teams will hope to improve on. Brereton Social, 14th with mixed recent form, travel to Widnes Town, who remain bottom of the division with just two points from seven games. Cheadle Heath Nomads, 17th and drawing their last two, host Telford Town away—both teams are struggling at the lower end with just one win apiece this season.
